<DropdownPreview />

##### Installation

<Code language="bash" tabs={true} code={`radianos add dropdown`} />

##### Imports

<Code
	language="tsx"
	code={`import { Dropdown, DropdownTrigger, DropdownContent, DropdownItem, DropdownSub, DropdownSubTrigger, DropdownSubContent } from "@/components/ui/tabs"`}
/>

##### Props

| Prop Name     | Default Values | Values           |
| ------------- | -------------- | ---------------- |
| selectionMode | undefined      | single, multiple |

##### Usage

<Code
	language="tsx"
	code={`<Dropdown>
        <DropdownTrigger>Dropdown</DropdownTrigger>
        <DropdownContent>
            <DropdownItem>This week</DropdownItem>
            <DropdownItem>This month</DropdownItem>
            <DropdownItem>This quarter</DropdownItem>
        </DropdownContent>
</Dropdown>
`}
/>
